title: Austin Considers Land Waivers & Lawsuit Deal
summary:
*   **Development Waivers Proposed**: City leaders began reviewing a proposal to extend a development rule waiver for the Bonita Vista Subdivision.
*   **Lawsuit Settlement Initiated**: Discussions started on settling a lawsuit with Bee Caves Partners Ltd., involving a conditional development waiver for Gill Ranch.
*   **Preliminary Approvals**: Both items received initial approval on their first reading, meaning final decisions will require further consideration.

The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, and member Urdy's second, passed
through FIRST READING ONLY an ordinance amending Ordinance No. 871029-J.to extend the

Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Urdy's second, passed through FIRST READING ONLY of
an ordinance authorizing settlement of Bee Caves Partners Ltd. v. City of Austin by
execution of a settlement agreement and passage of a conditional waiver pursuant to
Section 13-15-208 to Gill Ranch. (4-0 Vote, Mayor Pro Tem Shipman, Councilmembers
Barnstone and Nofziger absent) Council adjourned its meeting at 5:15 Ρ.Μ.
